description: Generate cheap round trips through several cities, from cached flights. Accepts one departure city (from) or up to 5 (from_cities); with several, a trip can return to a different one of them. Returns trips sorted by total price. To share or book a trip, pass its flight_ids to save_trip.

exclude_countries.description: Never visit cities in these ISO country codes.

from.description: Departure city name, exactly as returned by search_cities. Give from or from_cities.

from_cities.description: Several departure cities (up to 5), exactly as returned by search_cities. A trip leaves from one of them and may return to any of them.

include_countries.description: Only visit cities in these ISO country codes.

legs.description: Number of outbound flights before the flight home (1-7). The round trip adds one flight home, so the trip has legs+1 flights total.

limit.description: Maximum number of trips to return, default 5, max 10.

max_nights.description: Maximum nights in each city, default 3.

min_nights.description: Minimum nights in each city, default 2.

name: plan_trips
title: Plan multi-city trips
